details: My project is basically a game where you get to design your own space telescope and see whether your decisions will actually lead to a successful mission. You choose the launch vehicle, telescope components, scientific instruments and deployment method, while trying to stay within a limited budget and payload mass. I also added a story, characters, and mini-games because I didn't want it to feel like a boring science lesson. The idea is to let students experience a little bit of what goes into planning a real space mission, learn through their own choices, and understand that even one small decision can affect the whole mission. I developed it using Ren'Py and Python, with the images and backgrounds used in the game. What makes it special to me is the mix of science, humour, storytelling and engineering. I wanted to create something where you don't just learn about space exploration, but actually get to try it yourself.
